name: smart_playlists
description: Rule-based playlist generator: builds native Volumio playlists from artist/album/genre/year/track/duration/added-date filters, with sorting and deduplication.
author: Celindir69

volumio_info.details: Generate native Volumio playlists automatically from a rules text file: artist lists with AND/OR filters on album, genre, year, title, track, duration, and days-since-added, plus custom sort order and track limits.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.2.0: rules history - every version of the rules is kept in /data/smart_playlists_data/history/ and taken back by itself when an uninstall or update lost them. 1.1.0: REST API for other frontends (Xplorio playlist editor): list, save, delete, run, preview. 1.0.1: keeps the rules when updating from 0.9.x (settings taken over from the old category; the default examples never overwrite the rules file).
